nav_prompt: What does your business need help with?
hero_note: Free to use. No account. No tracking.
search_privacy: Please do not type names, Social Security numbers or immigration status. Longer questions go to our AI provider so it can understand them. We do not save them.
search_count: Suggestions found: {n}. Use the up and down arrow keys to choose.
home_boardTitle: What do you need help with?
home_boardSub: Pick the problem. We will find AI tools that can help.
home_newToolsD: AI tools launched in 2026 that are too new for many reviews.
home_scoreTitle: A rating needs more than stars
home_scoreD: A five-star tool can still be wrong for you if it costs too much, only speaks English or takes a week to set up. Our score weighs all of it, and each tool's page shows how it adds up.
home_alreadyD: Tell us what you use today, such as QuickBooks, Square or a spreadsheet. We will show which tools connect to it, so you do not have to start over or type everything twice.
home_helpTitle: Want to talk to a person?
home_helpD: Free business advisors are available through programs the Small Business Administration supports. Their loan rules changed in 2026, so read our notice before you apply.
results_searching: Searching the web for more tools. This can take about 20 seconds. You can keep reading.
results_foundNew: Found {n} more on the web today, and checked their reviews.
results_foundNone: The web search found nothing new that passed our checks.
results_paused: Web search is paused right now. These tools were researched earlier.
results_failed: The web search did not work this time. These tools were researched earlier.
results_saveData: Your device is saving data, so we did not search the web automatically.
results_searchWeb: Search the web for more tools
results_didYouMean: Did you mean one of these?
results_noMatchQuery: We could not match that to a type of tool. Try other words, or choose from the list.
results_iceNote: These are community safety resources from nonprofit groups, and most do not use AI. We do not add apps to this list automatically, because a fake or unsafe app could put people at risk. Do not give your immigration status to an app you do not trust. This is general information, not legal advice.
results_legalNote: These tools can help you understand paperwork, but they are not lawyers. Ask a qualified professional before you sign or file anything important.
filter_onlyMine: Show only tools in this language
card_priceUnconfirmed: We could not confirm this price
card_needsSales: You must talk to a salesperson
wld_none: Ordinary software or a printable resource. No AI model runs.
wld_background-ml: Small models sort transactions, block fraud or rank results.
wld_optional-genai: Normal software, plus a large model about one task in five.
wld_translation: Specialized translation models, smaller than a chatbot's.
wld_llm-every-reply: A large language model runs for each reply.
wld_speech: A speech model generates each audio clip.
wld_image-video: An image model runs for each picture. Video uses far more.
wld_voice-agent: Speech recognition, a large model and a voice all run for each call.
compat_directD: One tool's own pages name the other as an integration.
compat_bridgeD: Both work with {via}, so information can move between them with a little setup.
compat_sharedD: We could not confirm a link. You may have to type some information twice.
compat_noneD: We could not confirm anything they share. Expect to copy information by hand.
compat_noneSaved: Save other tools to see how this one works with them.
tool_noReviewsYet: We could not confirm enough public reviews (at least 25) to show a rating. We would rather show nothing than guess.
tool_publicResourceNote: This is a nonprofit or government resource. Review sites do not measure these fairly, so we do not rate it with stars.
tool_reviewCheck: Each rating above was found on the page linked to it. Summary written by AI from those reviews. We do not write or host reviews.
tool_languageSource: See the list on their site
tool_languagesNote: These are the languages we could confirm from public pages. If yours is missing, it may still be available, so check their site.
tool_scoreNoReviews: We could not confirm reviews, so this score only uses the other five parts.
tool_startAlone: You can sign up on your own
tool_nothingConfirmed: We could not confirm any integrations from public pages. Check their site, or expect to copy information by hand.
tool_ratingLegend: How useful is this tool for you?
kit_sub: Groups of AI tools that fit a kind of business, with the cost and connections worked out.
kit_notice: Fees such as card processing are listed on each tool and are not in this total.
new_sub: AI tools with a stated launch date in 2026, found by web search. They are too new to have many reviews, so we do not score them. Start with a free trial, and read the terms before you pay.
my_alreadyD: We use this to show which tools connect to what you already have. It stays on this device.
my_needTwo: Save at least two tools to see how they work together.
my_savingOff: Saving is off. Your list will disappear when you close this page.
my_saved: Saved on this device. Nothing is sent to us.
consent_q: Save your choices on this device?
consent_d: We do not track you. Your saved tools stay in this browser, and you can delete them at any time. By accepting, you confirm you are 18 or older.
footer_business: ImmigrAI is a prototype, not yet a registered company.
footer_independent: We are not paid by the tools we list, and no tool can pay for a better position. Prices and ratings can change, so confirm them on each tool's website.
footer_notAdvice: Not legal, tax, immigration or financial advice.
doc_translated: This page was translated by machine. The English version is the one that counts.
doc_contactPending: A contact address will be published before this prototype launches publicly.
doc_deleteButton: Delete my data from this browser
doc_deleted: Your data has been deleted from this browser.
doc_confirmQ: Delete all your saved tools, ratings and notes from this browser? This cannot be undone.
method_carbonD: Grams of CO2 equivalent per task
method_computeD: Tokens processed, model size and computing resources
notfound_title: We could not find that page.
notfound_d: The link may be old. You can start again from the home page.
error_title: Something went wrong on this page.
error_d: Please try again. Nothing you saved has been lost.
faq3_a: We search public review sites such as G2, Capterra, Trustpilot and the app stores. A rating only counts if it appears on the page we link to and there are at least 25 reviews. We do not write or host reviews.
my_onlyPaper: Only use paper or just a phone? That is fine. The Start-up Essentials kit is a good place to begin.
tool_saveToRate: Save this tool to rate it, keep notes and mark that you use it.
card_smallTool: Small or new tool. Try it before you pay.
tool_smallNote: This looks like a small or new tool. Try the free plan or trial first, and read the terms before you pay.
hero_ai: Every tool shows what its AI actually does.
home_how2_d: We search the web for AI tools, including small and new ones, then check their prices and reviews.
faq6_a: We focus on AI tools, including small and new ones, and each tool says what its AI does. A few helpful resources without AI, such as know-your-rights guides and free advisors, are labeled "No AI".
my_languageD: Choose the language you work in. We will check every tool for it, even if this website is not translated into it yet.
my_languageNoSite: This website is not translated into {language} yet, but we will still check each tool for it.
